about.title: What this is
about.p1: Did I is the unanswered question for tonight. One at a time. Hit DID if you did it. Hit nope if tonight is not that night.
about.p4: The day folds at the hour you set. A 1am tap still belongs to last night if the fold is 4. Reminders fire on this device when a question is due, if you turned them on.

site.door.title: Did I lock the back door?
site.door.p1: Did I is the unanswered question for tonight. One on the plate. Hit DID if you did it. Hit nope if tonight is not that night.
site.door.p2: Home says what is left. Tonight is where you tap DID or nope. Folders group questions. The cog is settings.
site.door.p3: No account. This browser keeps your questions. Hayes Street is a made-up apartment if you want a full set to try first.
site.name.title: Name this phone.
site.name.body: Your questions stay on this computer. There is no email and no password. Try a demo if you want to tap around without writing questions first.
site.name.label: Folder name
site.read.title: How to use it.
site.read.p1: Home is the front. It tells you what is left tonight. Tonight is the tap. One question. DID or nope. Finish tonight and the streak goes up. Come back tomorrow.
site.read.p2: A question can wait until a clock time. Coming up shows the next nights so a waiting question is not a blank screen. Last time is last night, or the last due day, if you missed it. Late still counts.
site.read.p3: Add a question from Questions, or start from What to ask. It can be every day, some weekdays, monthly, every few days, or once. The day folds at the hour in Settings, so a 1am tap still belongs to last night if the fold is 4.
site.read.p4: This phone keeps your questions. There is no email. Settings has a copy of the file, an optional number lock, and reminders. Chrome and Android can ping at the ask-after hour. An iPhone can install the page. Pings there are weak until a Mac builds the native app.
site.read.p5: y or space is DID. s is nope. n adds a question. Escape closes a plate. u undoes the last tap for a few seconds.
site.into.title: If you already run a React app.
site.into.p1: Copy the src/lib folder into your src folder.
site.into.code:
import { Tonight, sampleBoard, emptyBoard } from './lib'

<Tonight value={book} onChange={setBook} />
site.into.p2: Tonight does not write localStorage. Persist in the host. Pass now if you need a frozen clock.
